text: id: FES000001 name: Srivari Brahmotsavam alternate_names: - Tirumala Brahmotsavam - Salakatla Brahmotsavam category: Temple Festival / Religious occurrence_month: September / October (Bhadrapada / Asvina) duration_days: 9 associated_entity_type: Temple associated_entity_id: TMP000001 location_id: LOC000001 significance: The most important annual festival at Tirumala, celebrated to commemorate Lord Brahma's worship of Lord Venkateswara. key_rituals: - Ankurarpanam (Seed Sowing) - Dhwajarohanam (Flag Hoisting) - Garuda Vahana Seva (5th Day) - Rathotsavam (Car Festival) - Chakra Snanam (Sacred Bath) cultural_highlights: - Processions of processional deity (Malayappa Swamy) on golden vehicles - Nada Neerajanam musical concerts - Folk dance troupes performing in Mada Streets images: - tirumala_garuda_seva.jpg
- rathotsavam_tirumala.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Srivari Brahmotsavam', 'Tirumala', 'Garuda Seva', 'Malayappa Swamy', 'TTD'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'Tirupati', 'Brahmotsavam', 'Religious']

id: FES000002 name: Dasara Navaratri Utsavams alternate_names: - Vijayawada Dasara - Indrakeeladri Navaratri category: Temple Festival / Cultural occurrence_month: September / October (Ashvin) duration_days: 10 associated_entity_type: Temple associated_entity_id: TMP000003 location_id: LOC000003 significance: Grand celebration of Goddess Kanaka Durga's victory over Mahishasura; attracts millions of pilgrims to Vijayawada. key_rituals: - Daily Alankarams (Sri Bala Tripura Sundari to Rajarajeshwari Devi) - Saraswati Puja (Moola Nakshatram Day) - Teppotsavam (Float Festival in Krishna River on Vijayadashami) cultural_highlights: - Hamsa Vahanam float procession in Krishna River - Traditional Kolatam and classical dance programs on Indrakeeladri images: - kanaka_durga_teppotsavam.jpg - indrakeeladri_dasara_lights.jpg
ai_metadata: keywords: ['Dasara', 'Kanaka Durga', 'Vijayawada', 'Teppotsavam', 'Navaratri'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'Vijayawada', 'Navaratri', 'Durga']

id: FES000003 name: Maha Shivaratri Brahmotsavam alternate_names: - Srisailam Shivaratri - Srisailam Mahotsavam category: Temple Festival / Religious occurrence_month: February / March (Magha) duration_days: 11 associated_entity_type: Temple associated_entity_id: TMP000002 location_id: LOC000002 significance: Annual 11-day celebration of the divine wedding of Lord Mallikarjuna and Goddess Bhramaramba at Srisailam Jyotirlinga. key_rituals: - Pagalankara (Pagada Alankarana) by Chenchu tribals - Linga Abhishekam during Lingodbhava Kala - Kalyanotsavam (Divine Wedding) - Rathotsavam cultural_highlights: - Chenchu tribal dance rituals and offerings - Jagaran (overnight vigil) devotion images: - srisailam_shivaratri_chariot.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Shivaratri', 'Srisailam', 'Mallikarjuna', 'Pagalankara',
'Jyotirlinga'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'Srisailam', 'Shivaratri', 'Shiva']

id: FES000004 name: Sankranti (Makara Sankranti) alternate_names: - Pedda Panduga - Telugu Sankranti category: Harvest Festival / Cultural occurrence_month: January (Pushya) duration_days: 4 associated_entity_type: Statewide associated_entity_id: None location_id: None significance: The biggest cultural harvest festival celebrated across rural and urban Andhra Pradesh marking the sun's transition into Capricorn. key_rituals: - Day 1: Bhogi (Bonfire and Bhogi Pallu for children) - Day 2: Makara Sankranti (Muggulu/Rangoli competition and Haridasu visits) - Day 3: Kanuma (Cattle worship and agricultural honors) - Day 4: Mukkanuma (Community feasts) cultural_highlights: - Gangireddu (decorated bull) performances - Kite flying and Gobbemmalu displays - Cockfighting in rural coastal belts - Preparation

of Ariselu and traditional sweets images: - sankranti_muggulu_rangoli.jpg - haridasu_sankranti.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Sankranti', 'Pedda Panduga', 'Haridasu', 'Bhogi', 'Kanuma', 'Ariselu'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'Harvest', 'Cultural', 'AndhraPradesh']

id: FES000005 name: Ugadi alternate_names: - Telugu New Year - Yugadi category: New Year / Cultural occurrence_month: March / April (Chaitra) duration_days: 1 associated_entity_type: Statewide associated_entity_id: None location_id: None significance: Marks the beginning of the new era and Hindu lunar calendar year in Andhra Pradesh. key_rituals: - Preparation and tasting of Ugadi Pachadi (mix of six tastes symbolizing life's emotions) - Panchanga Sravanam (reading of the annual astrological almanac) - Kavi Sammelanam (Poets' meets in cultural centers) cultural_highlights: - Doorways decorated with mango leaves and neem flowers - State-level literary awards presentation images: - ugadi_pachadi_traditional.jpg - panchanga_sravanam.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Ugadi', 'Ugadi Pachadi', 'Panchanga
Sravanam', 'Telugu New Year'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'NewYear', 'Cultural', 'AndhraPradesh']

id: FES000006 name: Chandanotsavam (Chandana Yatra) alternate_names: - Simhachalam Chandanotsavam category: Temple Festival / Religious occurrence_month: May (Vaisakha Suddha Vidiya) duration_days: 1 associated_entity_type: Temple associated_entity_id: TMP000005 location_id: LOC000045 significance: The only day of the year when the sandalwood paste covering Lord Varaha Lakshmi Narasimha is removed, revealing His true form (Nijaroopa). key_rituals: - Nijaroopa Darshanam (12-hour viewing window) - Removal of previous year's Chandanam paste - Application of fresh sandalwood paste (Mundala Chandanam) cultural_highlights: - Lakhs of devotees climb Simhachalam hill for dawn queue lines images: - simhachalam_nijaroopa_darshan.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Chandanotsavam', 'Simhachalam', 'Nijaroopa
Darshanam', 'Varaha Narasimha', 'Vizag'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'Visakhapatnam', 'Simhachalam', 'Narasimha']

id: FES000007 name: Ratha Saptami alternate_names: - Magha Saptami - Surya Jayanti category: Temple Festival / Religious occurrence_month: January / February (Magha) duration_days: 1 associated_entity_type: Temple associated_entity_id: TMP000031 location_id: LOC000089 significance: Celebrates the birthday of Sun God (Surya Bhagavan); celebrated with grandeur at Arasavalli Sun Temple and Tirumala. key_rituals: - One-day Mini-Brahmotsavam at Tirumala (Deity taken on 7 different Vahanams from sunrise to night) - Special Ksheerabhishekam at Arasavalli Sun Temple - Surya Namaskar rituals by ocean coasts cultural_highlights: - Sun ray alignment viewing at Arasavalli sanctum images: - arasavalli_ratha_saptami.jpg - tirumala_surya_prabha_vahanam.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Ratha Saptami', 'Arasavalli',
'Surya Jayanti', 'Tirumala 7 Vahanams', 'Sun Temple'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'Srikakulam', 'SunTemple', 'Tirupati']

id: FES000008 name: Rottela Panduga alternate_names: - Roti Festival - Bara Shaheed Dargah Festival category: Interfaith / Cultural Festival occurrence_month: October / November (Muharram period) duration_days: 3 associated_entity_type: Dargah / Shrine associated_entity_id: LOC000075 location_id: LOC000075 significance: Unique syncretic festival celebrated at Bara Shaheed Dargah in Nellore where people of all religions exchange flatbreads (rotti) to fulfill vows. key_rituals: - Exchanging Roti in Swarnala Cheruvu tank water - Categorized Roti exchanges (Sowbhagya Roti for marriage, Vidya Roti for education, Arogya Roti for health) - Offering prayers at the tombs of 12 Martyrs (Bara Shaheed) cultural_highlights: - Massive secular gathering of Hindu, Muslim, and Christian devotees images: - rottela_panduga_swarnala_cheruvu.jpg

- bara_shaheed_dargah.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Rottela Panduga', 'Roti Festival', 'Nellore', 'Bara Shaheed Dargah', 'Swarnala Cheruvu'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'Nellore', 'Interfaith', 'Cultural']

id: FES000009 name: Flamingo Festival alternate_names: - Pulicat Bird Festival category: Eco-Tourism / Cultural occurrence_month: January / February duration_days: 3 associated_entity_type: Bird Sanctuary associated_entity_id: LOC000075 location_id: LOC000075 significance: Eco-tourism festival organized by AP Tourism at Sullurpeta near Pulicat Lake and Nelapattu Bird Sanctuary to celebrate migratory birds. key_rituals: - Bird Watching Expeditions at Pulicat Lagoon & Nelapattu - Environmental Awareness Exhibitions - Boating competitions on Pulicat Lake cultural_highlights: - Cultural music and dance performances showcasing coastal Nellore traditions - Photography contests images: - flamingo_festival_pulicat.jpg - nelapattu_birds.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Flamingo Festival', 'Pulicat Lake',
'Nelapattu', 'Sullurpeta', 'Eco Tourism', 'Nellore'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'EcoTourism', 'Nellore', 'BirdWatching']

id: FES000010 name: Visakha Utsav alternate_names: - Vizag Beach Festival category: Tourism / Cultural Carnival occurrence_month: December / January duration_days: 3 associated_entity_type: City Tourism associated_entity_id: LOC000046 location_id: LOC000046 significance: The official annual cultural and tourism carnival hosted along RK Beach promenade in Visakhapatnam by APTDC. key_rituals: - Carnival Parade along Beach Road - Flower show and Food festival setups - Traditional folk art shows (Dhimsa, Tappeta Gullu, Kolatam) cultural_highlights: - Music concerts by national artists - Water sports demonstrations at Rushikonda - Laser and firework shows over RK Beach images: - visakha_utsav_parade.jpg - vizag_beach_festival_lights.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Visakha Utsav', 'Vizag Beach Festival',
'RK Beach', 'APTDC Carnival', 'Dhimsa Dance'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'Visakhapatnam', 'Carnival', 'Tourism']

id: FES000011 name: Vaikuntha Ekadasi alternate_names: - Mukkoti Ekadasi - Vaikuntha Dwara Darshanam category: Temple Festival / Religious occurrence_month: December / January (Dhanurmasam) duration_days: 10 associated_entity_type: Temple associated_entity_id: TMP000001 location_id: LOC000001 significance: Auspicious day when the Vaikuntha Dwaram (northern gates of heaven) inside Vishnu temples opens to grant salvation to devotees. key_rituals: - Opening of Vaikuntha Dwaram at 00:00 midnight - Special Abhishekam and Sahasra Namarchana - Mukkoti Ekadasi Procession of Lord Malayappa Swamy on Golden Chariot cultural_highlights: - Lakhs of devotees lining up for northern gate passage - Special floral decorations (Pushpa Alankarana) inside temple sanctum images: - vaikuntha_dwaram_tirumala.jpg -

mukkoti_ekadasi_golden_chariot.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Vaikuntha Ekadasi', 'Mukkoti Ekadasi', 'Vaikuntha Dwaram', 'Tirumala', 'Dhanurmasam'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'Tirupati', 'Religious', 'Vishnu']

id: FES000012 name: Kotappakonda Prabha Utsavam alternate_names: - Kotappakonda Shivaratri - Trikuteswara Swamy Fair category: Temple Festival / Folk Carnival occurrence_month: February / March (Maha Shivaratri) duration_days: 1 associated_entity_type: Temple associated_entity_id: LOC000126 location_id: LOC000126 significance: Massive folk Shivaratri festival at Trikuta Hill in Palnadu where surrounding villages bring giant illuminated towers (Prabhas). key_rituals: - Bringing towering 60-100 feet decorated wooden Prabhas on bullock carts and tractors - Light illumination displays on Prabha towers at night - Abhishekam to Lord Trikuteswara Swamy cultural_highlights: - Spectacular night illumination of hundreds of Prabha structures along hill slopes - Folk music, Kolatam, and local cultural

performances images: - kotappakonda_giant_prabha.jpg - kotappakonda_night_illumination.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Kotappakonda', 'Prabha Utsavam', 'Shivaratri', 'Palnadu', 'Trikuteswara'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'Palnadu', 'Shivaratri', 'Folk']

id: FES000013 name: Kanipakam Vinayaka Chavithi Brahmotsavam alternate_names: - Kanipakam Ganesha Utsavam - Varasiddhi Vinayaka Brahmotsavams category: Temple Festival / Religious occurrence_month: August / September (Bhadrapada) duration_days: 21 associated_entity_type: Temple associated_entity_id: TMP000043 location_id: LOC000043 significance: A grand 21-day annual celebration of Lord Varasiddhi Vinayaka at Kanipakam well-shrine in Chittoor district. key_rituals: - Gramotsavam and Dhwajarohanam - Daily Vahana Sevas (Siddhi-Buddhi Sametha Vinayaka on Mooshika, Peacock, and Elephant vehicles) - Rathotsavam (Car Festival) - Teppotsavam in Bahuda River cultural_highlights: - Classical music and dance concerts arranged by AP Endowments Dept - Special Modaka and Laddu prasadam distributions images:

- kanipakam_vinayaka_chariot.jpg - kanipakam_teppotsavam.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Kanipakam', 'Vinayaka Chavithi', 'Ganesha', 'Brahmotsavam', 'Chittoor'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'Chittoor', 'Ganesha', 'Kanipakam']

id: FES000014 name: Antarvedi Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Kalyanotsavam alternate_names: - Antarvedi Jathara - Antarvedi Fair category: Temple Festival / Religious occurrence_month: January / February (Magha Suddha Saptami to Ekadasi) duration_days: 9 associated_entity_type: Temple associated_entity_id: TMP000035 location_id: LOC000035 significance: Annual celestial wedding celebration of Lord Narasimha Swamy and Goddess Rajya Lakshmi at the Godavari-ocean confluence. key_rituals: - Kalyanotsavam (Divine Wedding) on Bhishma Ekadasi - Rathotsavam (Grand Chariot Procession) - Chakra Snanam holy dip at Godavari-Sea confluence (Anna Chellela Gattu) cultural_highlights: - Massive beach congregation of pilgrims taking holy dips at the sea confluence - Traditional coastal Andhra carnivals and handloom

fairs images: - antarvedi_rathotsavam.jpg - antarvedi_kalyanotsavam.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Antarvedi', 'Kalyanotsavam', 'Bhishma Ekadasi', 'Godavari Confluence', 'Konaseema'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'Konaseema', 'Narasimha', 'Religious']

id: FES000015 name: Sirimanotsavam alternate_names: - Sirimanu Utsav - Pydivithalli Ammavari Jathara category: Temple Festival / Folk Tradition occurrence_month: October (First Tuesday after Vijayadashami) duration_days: 1 associated_entity_type: Temple associated_entity_id: LOC000130 location_id: LOC000130 significance: Historic folk festival celebrating Goddess Pydivithalli, featuring the chief priest riding suspended atop a 60-foot raised wooden pole (Sirimanu). key_rituals: - Sirimanu Procession (Priest seated on the long pole blessings crowds) - Anjali Ratham (Procession of royal palanquin) - White Elephant (Gaja Ratham) and Chariot procession through Vizianagaram streets cultural_highlights: - Tappeta Gullu folk dance troupes leading the procession - Royal family of Vizianagaram Fort

hosting temple traditions images: - sirimanu_procession_vizianagaram.jpg - pydivithalli_ammavari_jathara.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Sirimanotsavam', 'Pydivithalli', 'Vizianagaram', 'Sirimanu', 'Folk Jathara'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'Vizianagaram', 'Folk', 'Jathara']

id: FES000016 name: Poleramma Jathara (Venkatagiri) alternate_names: - Venkatagiri Poleramma Jathara category: Folk Festival / Grama Devata occurrence_month: September / October duration_days: 2 associated_entity_type: Grama Devata Shrine associated_entity_id: LOC000075 location_id: LOC000075 significance: Centuries-old village deity fair celebrated in Venkatagiri town to seek Goddess Poleramma's protection against diseases and epidemics. key_rituals: - Making of clay idol of Goddess Poleramma - Prathistapana and nocturnal offerings - Nimajjanam (Immersion of clay deity in local water body at dawn) cultural_highlights: - Veshalu (devotees dressing up as mythological and folk characters) - Traditional Venkatagiri sari handloom exhibitions during jathara images: - venkatagiri_poleramma_idol.jpg
ai_metadata: keywords: ['Poleramma Jathara', 'Venkatagiri', 'Grama Devata', 'Tirupati District', 'Folk Fair'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'Tirupati', 'Folk', 'Jathara']

id: FES000017 name: Lepakshi Heritage Festival alternate_names: - Lepakshi Utsav category: Cultural & Heritage Festival occurrence_month: February / March duration_days: 2 associated_entity_type: Heritage Monument associated_entity_id: TMP000016 location_id: LOC000016 significance: State cultural festival organized by AP Tourism at the historic Veerabhadra Temple complex to celebrate Vijayanagara art and dance. key_rituals: - Sound and Light (Son et Lumière) show highlighting Lepakshi history - Classical dance recitals in front of monolithic Nandi and Nagalinga cultural_highlights: - Performances by renowned Kuchipudi and Bharatanatyam artists - Crafts fair highlighting Rayalaseema artisans and cuisine images: - lepakshi_utsav_dance.jpg - lepakshi_light_show.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Lepakshi
Utsav', 'Vijayanagara Heritage', 'Monolithic Nandi', 'Sri Sathya Sai', 'APTDC'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'Heritage', 'Rayalaseema', 'Tourism']

id: FES000018 name: Devaragattu Banni Utsavam alternate_names: - Banni Stick Fight Festival - Mala Malleswara Swamy Banni Utsav category: Folk Festival / Ritual occurrence_month: October (Vijayadashami night) duration_days: 1 associated_entity_type: Temple associated_entity_id: LOC000047 location_id: LOC000047 significance: Ancient traditional ritual at Neraniki hillock in Kurnool district where villagers engage in a ceremonial stick fight to secure processional idols. key_rituals: - Midnight procession of Mala Malleswara Swamy idols up the hill - Ceremonial stick (Banni) contest between rival groups of surrounding villages - Flame torches (Diviteelu) lighting the hilltop battleground cultural_highlights: - High-energy martial folk spectacle involving thousands of torch-bearing villagers images:

- devaragattu_banni_festival.jpg - banni_stick_fight_kurnool.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Devaragattu', 'Banni Utsavam', 'Stick Fight Festival', 'Kurnool', 'Malleswara Swamy'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'Kurnool', 'Folk', 'Rayalaseema']

id: FES000019 name: Lumbini Festival alternate_names: - Andhra Buddhist Heritage Festival category: Cultural & Tourism Festival occurrence_month: December / January duration_days: 3 associated_entity_type: Buddhist Heritage Circuit associated_entity_id: CAV000003 location_id: LOC000003 significance: Tourism festival organized by AP Tourism to highlight the rich Buddhist heritage of Andhra Pradesh (Nagarjunakonda, Amaravati, Bojjannakonda). key_rituals: - Buddhist chanting and prayer ceremonies led by international monks - Heritage walks across ancient stupas and rock-cut cave circuits cultural_highlights: - Exhibitions detailing Acharya Nagarjuna's philosophy - International cultural exchange programs and seminars images: - lumbini_festival_monks.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Lumbini Festival',
'Buddhist Circuit', 'Amaravati', 'Nagarjunakonda', 'AP Tourism'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'Buddhism', 'Heritage', 'Tourism']

id: FES000020 name: Pelican Festival (Atapaka) alternate_names: - Kolleru Bird Festival category: Eco-Tourism Festival occurrence_month: February / March duration_days: 2 associated_entity_type: Bird Sanctuary associated_entity_id: LOC000111 location_id: LOC000111 significance: Eco-festival celebrated at Atapaka Bird Sanctuary (Kolleru Lake) to mark the annual nesting season of spot-billed pelicans and painted storks. key_rituals: - Bird Watching Tours on Kolleru Lake boats - Wildlife photography competitions - Community environmental pledge sessions by local wetland villagers cultural_highlights: - Folk art and drama shows raising wetland conservation awareness images: - pelican_festival_kolleru.jpg - atapaka_pelicans.jpg ai_metadata: keywords: ['Pelican Festival', 'Kolleru Lake', 'Atapaka',
'Eluru', 'Eco Tourism'] search_tags: ['Festivals', 'EcoTourism', 'Eluru', 'BirdWatching']
